column1: # LOSAT -db fixtures (db_search_fixtures.py): rows that run `LOSAT PROGRAM -db DB -query QUERY EXTRA_ARGS -outfmt OUTFMT` from LOSAT/ (program: blastp, blastn, tblastn, blastx or tblastx).

# kind ncbi: stdout, stderr and exit status (rc) equal the frozen bytes of NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 `PROGRAM -db ... -num_threads 1` (LOSAT/tests/fixtures/db_search/<row_id>.out, .err when stderr is not empty).
# kind losat-rejection: LOSAT exits with rc, stdout is empty, stderr contains the text after `expect: ` in covers (to a ` | ` or the end); the hash columns are empty.

# Rows db.ps.* (line PS, PS1): psiblast's first round against tests/db_search/paja, the queries of tests/fasta/psiblast/ (WSSV proteins of tests/fasta/WSSV.faa and constructed records); the ncbi rows are NCBI 2.17.0 `psiblast -db ... -num_threads 1`.
# Rows db.sa.*.5 (OF4a): -outfmt 5 (BLAST XML) of BLASTN and BLASTP, each the search of the db.sa.*.8 row of the same stem (stdout is the XML document; hit ids gnl|BL_ORD_ID|N).

# Rows db.sa.{blastx,tblastn,tblastx}.*.5 and db.x5.* (OF4b): the same for BLASTX, TBLASTN and TBLASTX; db.x5.* use the mixed query files tests/fasta/outfmt0/x5_* (each with a query without hits), db.x5.*.nohit_all has no hit for any query.

# Rows db.sa.*.1[56], db.x16.* and db.x16_*taxid.* (OF5a for BLASTP and BLASTN, OF5b for BLASTX, TBLASTN and TBLASTX): -outfmt 16 (BLAST XML2) and 15 (BLAST JSON) of all five programs, the search of the .5 or .8 row of the same stem where the covers cell says so; BLASTDB=DIR, BATCH_SIZE=N and ARCHIVE_FORMAT=X tokens in extra_args are environment variables of the NCBI run and of LOSAT's.
# db: path relative to LOSAT/ (an empty cell is -db ""); extra_args is split like a shell line; outfmt is one argument; stdout_sha256, stdout_bytes and stderr_sha256 are written by `freeze`.

# Rows db.sa.* (line OF, OF3b): -outfmt 8 (Seq-annot, ASN.1 text) and 12 (Seq-annot, JSON) and, in the ids ending .9 (OF3c), 9 (Seq-annot, binary ASN.1; the fixture files are binary, see fixtures/db_search/.gitattributes); freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.sa.`.

# Rows db.x16.blastx.mix.13, db.sa.x16_ttaxid.good.13, db.sa.x16_xtaxid.good.14 (OF5c part 2, BLASTX, TBLASTN and TBLASTX): the same for the programs of part 2, the search of the .16 row of the same stem.

# Rows db.sa.*.1[34] (OF5c, BLASTP and BLASTN): -outfmt 14 and 13 (side files and a master file) of the search of the .16/.15 row of the same stem. The files column is xinclude: the runner adds `-out <tmp>/<row_id>.out`; the master is frozen as <row_id>.out (stdout_sha256, stdout_bytes; standard output is empty), the side files as <row_id>.out_<n>.xml|json (side_sha256, in order). A row of the old form has 12 cells and no files columns (LOSAT/tests/xinclude_fixtures.py).

# Rows db.numdesc.* (line NP, O1b): -num_descriptions and -num_alignments (blast_args.cpp:2894-2973); the last one is NCBI's error for a hit list size of 0 (rc 1, empty stdout); freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.numdesc.`.
# Rows db.blastp.culling_* and db.tblastn.culling_* (line NP, O3b): -culling_limit with -db; freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.blastp.culling_` / `--only db.tblastn.culling_`.

# Rows db.sa.arch.bn.* (line OF, OF8a): -outfmt 11 (BLAST archive, ASN.1 text; ARCHIVE_FORMAT=bin|BIN: binary; =foo: nothing) of BLASTN with `-db tests/db_search/arch_snucl`, each with the .8 and .5 rows of the same search so that check_archive_layout.py predict rebuilds the archive; freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.sa.arch.`.

# Rows db.sa.arch.tbn.* (line OF, OF8b2): -outfmt 11 (BLAST archive, ASN.1 text; ARCHIVE_FORMAT=bin|BIN: binary; =foo: nothing) of TBLASTN with `-db tests/db_search/arch_tbn_snucl` (version 4, no -parse_seqids: makeblastdb -in tests/fasta/outfmt11/arch_tbn_s.fna -dbtype nucl -title snucdb -blastdb_version 4; .nhr .nin .nsq kept), each with the .8 and .5 rows of the same search so that check_archive_layout.py predict rebuilds the archive; freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.sa.arch.tbn.`.

# Rows db.sa.arch.tbx.* (line OF, OF8b3): -outfmt 11 (BLAST archive, ASN.1 text; ARCHIVE_FORMAT=bin|BIN: binary; =foo: nothing) of TBLASTX with `-db tests/db_search/arch_tbx_snucl` (version 4, no -parse_seqids: makeblastdb -in tests/fasta/outfmt11/arch_tbx_s.fna -dbtype nucl -title snucdb -blastdb_version 4; .nhr .nin .nsq kept), each with the .8 and .5 rows of the same search so that check_archive_layout.py predict rebuilds the archive; freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.sa.arch.tbx.`.

# Rows db.wm.* (line NP, M2): blastn -window_masker_db (counts tests/winmask/counts/mg1655_u9.obinary) against the database tests/db_search/wm_s60k (README.md there); the masks of each query chunk are those of its own letters (CHUNK_SIZE=600 and 400), also with -strand minus (the reverse complement's intervals); the -subject rows are the wm.* cases of tests/blastn_regression_fixtures.py. Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --ncbi-bin DIR --only db.wm.
# Rows db.score.tblastx.* (line NP, series SCT, SC7): TBLASTX -matrix with -db (the rows score.tblastx.* of outfmt0_manifest.tsv are the -subject ones).
